checks.text: The page displays the heading "Mind Map" and the toolbar contains buttons labeled "Add Node", "Connect", "Brush", "Eraser", "Export PNG", and "Auto Layout".
Clicking the button "Add Node" creates a new node on the canvas with the default label "New Idea" and a unique ID visible in the node's title attribute.
Double-clicking a node with the label "New Idea" and typing "Strategy" then pressing Enter changes the node's visible text to "Strategy".
Selecting the "Connect" tool, clicking a node labeled "Strategy", then clicking a node labeled "Goal" creates a visible edge between them; the status bar shows "1 connection".
Selecting the "Brush" tool, drawing a stroke on the canvas, and then clicking the button "Export PNG" triggers a file download with the name "mind-map.png".
Clicking the button "Auto Layout" rearranges the nodes so that no two nodes overlap, and the status bar shows "Layout updated".
Selecting a node labeled "Strategy" and pressing the Delete key removes the node and any connected edges; the status bar shows "0 connections" if it was the only connected node.
Changing the brush size slider to "5" and drawing a stroke results in a line with a width of 5 pixels, verifiable by inspecting the canvas element's data attributes.
Reload keeps the node labeled "Strategy" and the edge connecting it to "Goal" visible on the canvas.
